What is GST?

GST (Goods and Services Tax) is a single tax charged on the sale of most goods and services in India. It replaced a long list of separate central and state taxes with one system.

📊GUIDE

What is EMI?

EMI (Equated Monthly Instalment) is the scheduled amount you pay toward a loan each month, made up of principal and interest. Fixed-rate loans generally keep the EMI fixed, while floating-rate loans may change the EMI or tenure.

📈GUIDE

What is a Credit Score?

A credit score is a number calculated from your credit history, including repayment behaviour, outstanding debt and credit enquiries. In India, CIBIL commonly uses a 300–900 range, but each credit information company (CIC) calculates its own score and lender decisions also consider income, affordability and other information.

💸GUIDE

What is Inflation?

Inflation is the general rise in prices of goods and services over time, which means each rupee buys a little less than it used to.

Padhe → Read More

🔄GUIDE

What is Compound Interest?

Compound interest is interest calculated not just on your original amount, but also on the interest that has already been added to it — so your money grows faster over time compared to simple interest.

3 min readSimple Hindi + English
Padhe → Read More
✦ Samjho Original GuideFree to read
💳GUIDE

What is a Credit Card?

A credit card lets you borrow money from a bank up to a set limit to make purchases now, which you then repay by a due date — either in full, avoiding interest, or partially, which triggers interest charges.

3 min readSimple Hindi + English
Padhe → Read More
✦ Samjho Original GuideFree to read
🏦GUIDE

What is a Savings Account?

A savings account is a basic bank account designed for individuals to safely deposit money, earn a modest interest on the balance, and access funds relatively easily through withdrawals, transfers and cards.
